name: New patient welcome
why: New members decide in the first week whether the app is worth opening. A welcome, a how-it-works email and two gentle nudges to book turn sign-ups into first visits.
reward_text: Signup bonus and first-visit bonus (your point rules)

messages.label: Push: welcome
messages.title: Welcome to {{business}}, {{first_name}}
messages.body: Your rewards account is ready. You earn points on every visit, and your welcome gift is waiting in the app.

messages.label: Email: how the app works
messages.body:
Here's what your app does for you.

Earn points on every visit and purchase, then trade them for treatments and skincare.

Browse treatments and packages in the shop, and split bigger purchases into smaller payments where it's offered.

After each visit, your aftercare and the date you're due next show up in My care.
messages.subject: How your {{business}} app works
messages.preheader: Points, rewards, the shop and your aftercare, all in one place.
messages.heading: Everything in one place, {{first_name}}

messages.label: Push: book your first visit
messages.title: Ready for your first visit?
messages.body: Pick a time that works for you. Your first-visit points land as soon as you check in.

messages.label: Email: first-visit bonus
messages.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Book your first treatment and we'll add {{bonus}} bonus points when you check in, on top of the points you earn for the visit.

Not sure where to start? Give us a call and we'll help you choose.
messages.subject: +{{bonus}} points on your first visit
messages.heading: Your first-visit bonus is waiting

name: New in the app
why: When you add a featured treatment, a new reward or a post, members who haven't opened the app in two weeks get one short heads-up. Active members aren't bothered.
trigger_text: You post something new (featured shop item, reward or news)
timing_text: Within the hour · max 2 a month

messages.label: Push: new in the app
messages.title: New at {{business}}: {{offer_name}}
messages.body: Tap to see what's new, {{first_name}}.

name: Finish your order
why: Someone opened checkout for a package or product and didn't pay. Three touches bring a real share of them back, and the bonus only appears on the last one so you don't train people to wait.
reward_text: +200 points if they pay within 48 hours of the last message

messages.label: Push: still thinking?
messages.title: Still thinking about {{item}}?
messages.body: It's saved for you, {{first_name}}. Questions about results or downtime? Our team is happy to help.

messages.label: Email: your item is saved
messages.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

You were checking out {{item}}. It's still here whenever you're ready.

Prefer to spread it out? You can pay in 4 interest-free payments with Klarna at checkout.
messages.subject: Your {{item}} is saved
messages.preheader: Pick up where you left off, or spread the cost.
messages.heading: Still deciding on {{item}}?
messages.footnote: Or 4 interest-free payments of {{installment|a smaller amount}} with Klarna

messages.label: Push: bonus points
messages.title: Finish today, get +{{bonus}} points
messages.body: Complete your {{item}} order in the next 48 hours and we'll add {{bonus}} bonus points.

name: Viewed but didn't buy
why: A patient looked at a treatment or product more than once and left. One friendly reminder a few hours later, never more than once a week, and never if they already checked out or booked.
trigger_text: Viewed a treatment or product (10+ seconds or twice)

messages.label: Push: still curious?
messages.title: {{item}} at {{business}}
messages.body: Still curious? See the details, results and pricing, or book a quick consult.

name: Membership interest
why: Members visit more and stay longer. When someone looks at your membership, or comes in for a second time without one, they get the value spelled out and a join bonus.
trigger_text: Viewed membership, or 2nd visit as a non-member
timing_text: Day 1 · day 4 (or the day after the 2nd visit)
reward_text: +250 points when they join within 2 weeks

messages.label: Push: you've been in twice
messages.title: You've been in twice, {{first_name}}
messages.body: Members get {{member_value}}. See if it fits how often you visit.

messages.label: Push: what members get
messages.title: What members get at {{business}}
messages.body: Members get {{member_value}}. Tap to see the plans.

messages.label: Email: the yearly math
messages.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Members get {{member_value}}.

If you come in every month or two, membership usually pays for itself within the first few visits, and your points keep adding up on top.
messages.subject: Is a {{business}} membership worth it for you?
messages.preheader: The yearly math, in one minute.
messages.heading: Here's what membership adds up to
messages.footnote: Join in the next 2 weeks and get +{{bonus}} bonus points

name: Book after purchase
why: Patients who pay in the app still have to book in your scheduling system. A nudge the next day, and one more a few days later, turns purchases into appointments. Stops as soon as they book or come in.
trigger_text: Joined a membership or bought a treatment package

messages.label: Push: book your first visit
messages.title: Book your first visit, {{first_name}}
messages.body: Your {{business}} membership is active. Pick a time so you can start using it.

messages.label: Push: book your first session
messages.title: Ready to book {{item}}?
messages.body: Your sessions are waiting at {{business}}. Pick a time for the first one.

messages.label: Push: still need a time?
messages.title: Still need a time, {{first_name}}?
messages.body: Booking takes a minute. Tap to pick a time with {{business}}.

name: After your treatment
why: Patients feel looked after when aftercare arrives the same day and someone checks in a couple of days later. It also cuts down on worried calls to the front desk.
trigger_text: A visit is completed (booking, treatment log or check-in)

messages.label: Push: aftercare
messages.title: Aftercare for {{treatment}}
messages.body: Your aftercare steps are in the app, {{first_name}}. Questions? Give us a call anytime.

messages.label: Push: how are you feeling?
messages.title: How are you feeling after {{treatment}}?
messages.body: Most people feel back to normal by now. If anything seems off, call us, we're here to help.

name: Google review for points
why: The best time to ask for a review is the same day, while the visit is fresh. One reminder if they didn't get to it, then never again for 4 months. Points land when the desk verifies it.
trigger_text: A visit is completed, no review yet
timing_text: 3 hours · 6 days later if no review
reward_text: Your review points, added when the review is verified

messages.label: Push: review for points
messages.title: Loved your visit? Review us, get +{{bonus}} pts
messages.body: A quick Google review helps others find us. We'll add {{bonus}} points once it's verified.

messages.label: Email: a quick favor
messages.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

If you were happy with your visit, a short Google review means a lot to us, and it helps other people feel confident choosing {{business}}.

Once it's verified we'll add {{bonus}} points to your account.
messages.subject: A quick favor, {{first_name}}?
messages.heading: How was your visit?
messages.footnote: +{{bonus}} points when your review is verified

name: Time for your next treatment
why: Results fade on a schedule. Patients get a heads-up 10 days before their treatment is due, a reminder on the day, and a bonus if they're two weeks late. It stops the moment they book.
trigger_text: A logged treatment is due in 10 days (from its recall weeks)
timing_text: 10 days before · due date · 2 weeks after
reward_text: +150 points if they book within 7 days of the last reminder

messages.label: Push: due soon
messages.title: Your {{treatment}} is due soon
messages.body: You're due around {{due_date}}. Book now to keep your results on track, {{first_name}}.

messages.label: Email: due today
messages.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

It's about time for your next {{treatment}}. Staying on schedule is the easiest way to keep your results looking their best.

Pick a time that suits you, it only takes a minute.
messages.subject: Your {{treatment}} is due
messages.heading: Time for your next {{treatment}}

messages.label: Push: bonus to book
messages.when_text: 2 weeks after it's due, if not booked
messages.title: Book this week, get +{{bonus}} pts
messages.body: Your {{treatment}} is a little overdue. Book in the next 7 days and we'll add {{bonus}} bonus points.

name: Appointment reminders
why: Two reminders cut no-shows, and anyone who cancels or misses gets a kind nudge to pick a new time the next day. Reminders are service messages, so they don't count toward the weekly limit.
timing_text: 24 hours before · 2 hours before · day after a cancel

messages.label: Push: see you tomorrow
messages.title: See you tomorrow, {{first_name}}
messages.body: Your {{treatment}} at {{business}} is {{appt_time}}. Need to move it? Let us know as soon as you can.

messages.label: Push: see you soon
messages.title: See you soon
messages.body: Your appointment at {{business}} is in about 2 hours. Your prep notes are in the app.

messages.label: Push: new time
messages.when_text: 1 day after a cancellation or no-show
messages.title: Let's find you a new time
messages.body: Sorry we missed you, {{first_name}}. Pick a new time whenever it suits you.

name: We miss you
why: Patients who haven't been in for 90 days get three warm touches and a time-limited gift, then a 'lapsed' tag at 180 days so you can see who's slipping. Paying members get a softer version at 35 days.
trigger_text: No visit in 90 days (35 days for paying members)
reward_text: +200 points if they visit within 2 weeks of the gift email

messages.label: Push: perks waiting
messages.title: Your member perks are waiting, {{first_name}}
messages.body: It's been a little while. Your member pricing and benefits are ready whenever you are.

messages.label: Email: saving your spot
messages.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Just a friendly note that your membership benefits are ready to use. Regular visits are what keep results looking their best, and booking takes less than a minute.

If your schedule has been busy, give us a call and we'll find a time that works.
messages.subject: Saving your spot, {{first_name}}
messages.preheader: Your member benefits are ready to use.
messages.heading: We'd love to see you

messages.label: Push: it's been a while
messages.title: {{first_name}}, it's been a while
messages.body: It's been {{days_since_last_visit}} days since your last visit. Your results last longer with a touch-up, and your points are still here.

messages.label: Email: welcome-back gift
messages.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

We miss seeing you at {{business}}. Come in for any treatment in the next 2 weeks and we'll add {{bonus}} bonus points to your account, on top of your usual points.
messages.subject: A welcome-back gift for you
messages.preheader: +{{bonus}} points when you visit in the next 2 weeks.
messages.heading: We saved something for you, {{first_name}}
messages.footnote: +{{bonus}} points when you visit in the next 2 weeks

messages.label: Push: gift expires soon
messages.title: Your gift expires in 2 days
messages.body: Visit in the next 2 days and your {{bonus}} bonus points are yours, {{first_name}}.

name: Reward unlocked
why: The moment a patient's points cross a reward's cost they get the 'you unlocked' push (your existing automation) and a big photo email of the reward. If it's still unused two weeks later, one reminder gives them a reason to come in.
timing_text: Right away (push + email) · 14 days later if unused

messages.label: Email: you unlocked it
messages.body: Tap Redeem in the app and show your code at the desk on your next visit.
messages.subject: {{first_name}}, you've unlocked {{offer_name}}
messages.preheader: It's ready to redeem on your next visit.
messages.heading: You've unlocked {{offer_name}}

messages.label: Push: reward waiting
messages.title: Your {{offer_name}} is waiting
messages.body: You have {{points}} points, enough for {{offer_name}}. Redeem it in the app before your next visit.

name: Points earned
why: After a visit or purchase, patients see their new balance on a progress bar next to the rewards it gets them closer to. At most one a week, and never during the welcome week or right after an unlock email.

messages.label: Email: your points
messages.body: Every visit and purchase adds up. Here's what your points get you, and what's next.
messages.subject: You're at {{points}} points, {{first_name}}
messages.preheader: Here's what your points can get you at {{business}}.
messages.heading: You're at {{points}} points

name: Almost there
why: When a patient gets within a quarter of their next reward, one nudge tells them exactly how close they are. Close goals pull people back in sooner.
trigger_text: Points reach 75% of the next reward
reward_text: The next reward on their list

messages.label: Email: so close
messages.body: One more visit or a skincare pickup should do it. Your points land the moment you check in.
messages.subject: {{first_name}}, you're {{points_remaining}} points from {{offer_name}}
messages.preheader: One more visit should do it.
messages.heading: Just {{points_remaining}} points to {{offer_name}}

name: Reward expiring soon
why: A reward a patient already redeemed in the app but hasn't used at the desk gets one email three days before it expires, so nothing goes to waste. The last-48-hours push (Gifts about to expire) still runs.
trigger_text: A redeemed reward expires in 3 days

messages.label: Email: use it before it expires
messages.body: It's saved in your app until {{due_date}}. Show your code at the desk on your next visit and it's yours.
messages.subject: Your {{offer_name}} expires {{due_date}}
messages.preheader: Show your code at the desk before then.
messages.heading: Your {{offer_name}} is waiting

name: Birthday
why: On their birthday, patients get birthday points and your birthday gift card in the app. It runs on your existing birthday automations.
timing_text: On the day (checked hourly, local time)
reward_text: Birthday points (your point rules) + the birthday gift card

name: Bring a friend
why: Happy patients are the best source of new ones. Right after a verified review or a third visit, when they're most enthusiastic, they get a nudge to share their link.
trigger_text: A verified review, or the 3rd visit
reward_text: Your referral points for both people

messages.label: Push: bring a friend
messages.title: Give a friend +{{friend_bonus}} pts, get +{{bonus}} pts
messages.body: Know someone who'd love {{business}}? Share your link from the app. When they come in, you both get points.

name: Gifts about to expire
why: When a saved gift or reward is about to expire, the patient gets a reminder so nothing goes to waste. Runs on your existing expiry reminders.
trigger_text: A saved gift expires in under 48 hours
